testCase.expectations: TOEFL iBT Speaking practice mock for a Brazilian candidate at A2. Title and situation, in Brazilian Portuguese, call it a practice mock shorter than the real section, never an official test. Hints help interview answers (a reason, an example, a prediction) at A2 and never ask the examiner to repeat.
